pkgmetadata.longdescription: Strata is a C++/CUDA inference engine written for one model family, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (qwen4exp MoE). It keeps a per-expert VRAM cache filled from a routing profile and adapted to the conversation, computes GPU- and CPU-resident experts of a layer concurrently, and decodes with the model's own MTP head. Installed under /opt/strata; strata-serve starts the OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible server, strata-tool runs the pack tools.
